findings.text: a systematic review of 5,453 papers (1993–2002) is cited in Ch 1 as finding 2% reporting experiments, and a study of the same 5,453 papers is cited in Ch 13.1 as finding 1.9% reporting controlled experiments, of which 72.6% used students only as subjects [V]
findings.problem: 'the same 5,453 papers' is an inference the source does not make: Ch 1 cites ref 775 (Hannay, Sjøberg and Dybå 2007, a systematic review of theory use) and Ch 13.1 cites ref 1717 (Sjøberg et al. 2004, a survey of controlled experiments); the text never says the two share a paper set. The sentence also carries [V] though nothing in it is quoted.
findings.evidence: Source 10575-10577: 'a systematic review of 5,453 papers published between 1993 and 2002[775] found 2% reporting experiments'. Source 41852-41854: 'A study[1717] of 5,453 papers in software engineering journals, published between 1993 and 2002, found that only 1.9% reported controlled experiments (of which 72.6% used students, only, as subjects)'. Bib 49639-49643 (775), 53958-53961 (1717).
findings.fix: correct: a systematic review of 5,453 papers (1993–2002) is cited in Ch 1 as finding 2% reporting experiments, and a study of 5,453 papers in software engineering journals over the same years is cited in Ch 13.1 as finding 1.9% reporting controlled experiments, of which 72.6% used students only as subjects [AP] (Ch 1, "History of software engineering research"; Ch 13.1, "Introduction")
